text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The Representative Exchange Race came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Stream Chat
text_block_list.text:
"‘So hot~~! What an incredible race...!’
‘<chrname>! <chrname>!’
‘This year's world title is in the bag.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fired up by the thrill of the race, comments from the
viewers started pouring in one after another.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
――...<chrname>,
<chrname>......

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh, hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Good. Very good.
...Ah, I shall forgive you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>, and your companion.
This year, you two are to claim the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Accomplish what you desire.
Filling My mouth with the world's finest delicacies comes after that.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
For now, go and savor every last drop of victory.
And then, once you're shining brighter and brimming with brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I shall pierce through with a single stroke.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Go, monster.
To the peak of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
It makes for a far more thrilling finale to this epic.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Strive on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre walks away.
As if passing the baton she once held
into my hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —"I will definitely win, for your sake as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To continue those words, I reach a hand out to her back.
To the girl who has shown me her perspective, her pride,
and her heart as someone who "bears the weight"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Smack!!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Don't touch me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Victory is the only thing I have permitted you.
I have sanctioned no other self-indulgence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Grow stronger, as much as you can.
—Until the day I crush you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's 'Representative Exchange Race' had concluded.
At Mei Satake's call, the project participants lined up in formation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The announcement of Japan's representative team is about to begin.
I watch intently as—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —She was watching.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre declines to represent Japan.
However, she will accompany the chosen girls
and cooperate with their training.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
In addition, I've heard about your future plans
and feelings as you aim to become the best in the
world.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Let me state our goal once more.
—We are going to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Those who were chosen, and those who were not.
Their feelings are united as one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The responses overlapped.
The surrounding Umamusume and Trainers were shouting too,
their voices loud enough for everyone to hear.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Now, I shall read out the names of the Umamusume selected for the team.
The first is...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname>！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —At that moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, my eyes met Orfevre's.
And she...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —She bestowed a "Royal Command" upon us.
